forms: Service: plagiarism checking of student essays. Data the vendor receives: student submissions (may contain personal content) and student names. Students: learners on LearnTech's higher-education courses, all aged 18 or over. Volume: ~2 million documents/year, from about 90,000 students. Users: teachers see the similarity reports. draft.Security obligations and standards: Clause 7: Lumen maintains an information security programme aligned with ISO/IEC 27001 throughout the term.
draft.Confidentiality: Clause 9: Each party keeps the other's confidential information secret during the term and for five years after it ends.
draft.Data processing agreement (GDPR Art.28 o: Clause 11: Lumen processes personal data only on LearnTech's documented instructions. The data processing addendum in Schedule 2 forms part of this agreement.
draft.Incident notification within 24 hours: Clause 12: Lumen notifies LearnTech of a security incident without undue delay, and no later than 72 hours after confirming it.
draft.Audit rights: Clause 14: Each year Lumen gives LearnTech its current SOC 2 Type II report on request.
draft.Sub-processor approval: Clause 15: Lumen may engage sub-processors. It publishes the current list on its website.
draft.Exit and data return: Clause 20: When this agreement ends, Lumen deletes LearnTech's data within 90 days.
draft.Business continuity commitments: Nothing in the draft on recovery or continuity.

transfer: Clause 21: Lumen hosts the service in the United States.
